_doc: Técnicas originales de Victory Road que no lleva ninguna carta, pero que queremos en el catálogo para su TP (ver docs/balance-tecnicas-vr-originales.md). build.py las añade si faltan; el TP está en data/technique_balance.json.

techniques.name: Kraken Seaquake
techniques.description: Encircle your rival in a spiraling vortex and awaken the ocean's guardian to rise with a crashing wave and steal the ball.

techniques.name: Divine Deflectors
techniques.description: Tear open space itself and guide the ball along a path carved by celestial hands.

techniques.name: Stillness Drip
techniques.name_jp: スウェットスティルネス
techniques.description: Gather every ounce of power and catch the ball in a dazzling display of determination and skill.

techniques.name: God Hand EV
techniques.description: Envelop your hand in a rainbow wave with the ultimate evolution of God Hand to block any shot.

techniques.name: God Catch FT
techniques.description: Mastery of God Catch elevates the Majin to new heights, causing its rainbow aura to seal off the goal.

techniques.name: Mama's Helping Hand
techniques.description: Catch the shot with the helping hand of a mom fed up with her study-shirking kid!
